name: KEI Industries Ltd
tagline: High-quality wires & cables compounder with an EHV/HT niche and a data-centre tailwind — but large-cap, ~50x earnings, and now facing UltraTech, Adani and Birla entering the sector
business_overview: Organised wires & cables manufacturer; strength in EHV / HT / UHV cables (higher entry barriers than house wire), plus a small (~5-6% of revenue) EPC arm. Promoter ~35%, zero pledge.
fundamentals_table: ~50x trailing P/E (was ~51x even after a 32% correction)
Sanand plant ~Rs 1,800-2,000 Cr, ~Rs 5,000 Cr revenue capacity
20%+ revenue CAGR for 3-4 yrs; ~Rs 25,000 Cr revenue by 2030
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely high-quality: 20% ROCE, debt-free, 27% 5-yr profit CAGR, clean promoter. The problem is price and competitive structure. The stock trades near 50x for a ~20% grower, and FY25-26 saw a step-change in competition — UltraTech (Rs 1,800 Cr capex), Adani, and now the Aditya Birla group ('Ultravolt', Rs 1,800 Cr, targeting top-2 in 5 years) — each of which has corrected the whole sector sharply on announcement. Management argues new entrants need 3-5+ years to establish plants and brand, and that KEI's UHV/EHV niche is the least contestable. Copper price volatility and potential Chinese dumping in export markets are secondary margin risks.
sentiment_summary: Thread constructive but thinner lately; most posters invested and treat the new entrants as a slow-moving, multi-year threat rather than a near-term earnings risk, with KEI's cable (vs wire) mix seen as more defensible than Polycab's. Recent posts (Sep 2026) note the Birla 'Ultravolt' launch triggering another sharp correction in KEI/Polycab/RR Kabel.
community_signal: No trusted-roster high-conviction call in the recent window; karanshah137 contributed a neutral data-centre TAM sizing (Rs 2,500-3,000 Cr opportunity over 5-6 yrs).
key_new_facts: Aditya Birla group launched wires & cables business 'Ultravolt' (Rs 1,800 Cr, top-2 target in 5 yrs), Sep 2026 — sector corrected sharply.
Management reiterates 20%+ revenue CAGR and a Rs 25,000 Cr FY30 revenue target; Sanand ramp underway.
Data-centre cable demand cited as ~Rs 3,500-4,000 Cr per GW of DC capacity, KEI share ~11-13%.
bull_case: Structural electrification / grid / data-centre cable tailwind; organised players gain share from unorganised
EHV/UHV cable technical barriers + brand + distribution; clean, debt-free, 20% ROCE
27% 5-yr profit CAGR with a funded capacity runway (Sanand)
bear_case: Large-cap (~Rs 52,000 Cr) — no 10x/100x maths off this base
~50x earnings for a ~20% grower; thesis largely priced
Competitive step-change: UltraTech, Adani and Birla all entering with deep pockets
Copper-price swings and Chinese export-market dumping pressure margins
verdict_headline: Quality compounder, wrong size and price for this screen, and a competitive step-change underway — 'neither', Medium conviction
verdict_reasoning: Theme match: priority-1 'Copper & electrification metals' (keywords cable / wire and cable / conductor). Discovery candidate, recency-surfaced.
